restoration_note: The teaching is a litany of 'ⲧⲁⲣⲭⲏ' (Origin) statements tracing each class of good (gifts, blessings, counsels, honors, warriors, builders, releasers, wisdoms, awakenings) back to a specific divine entity from the Father of the Lights down to the Mind of Light. The recurring formula 'ⲧⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲛ̄... ⲡⲉ ...' constrains many fills tightly, as does the chain of named entities (Father of Greatness, Mother of Life, King of Glory, Beloved of the Lights, First Man, Great Builder, Omophoros, Releaser, Virgin of Light, Mind of Light). Editor proposals were largely confirmed, except {8}/{9} where the reading explicitly names the firmament rather than the cosmos as the King of Glory's seat — so I split ⲥⲧⲉⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ across the line break (matching {9}'s est_chars=6 = ⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ). Several short prepositional/morphological gaps remained too weakly constrained to fill ({19}–{24}, {28}–{29}) — these are pre-formula end-of-line residues, glosses, or transitional clauses without parallel anchors.

restorations.basis: Editor restoration of the chapter's structuring formula 'Ⲧⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲛ̄... ⲡⲉ' ('the Origin of... is...'); the visible -ⲏ following confirms ⲧⲁⲣⲭⲏ.
Article + adjectival prefix completing ⲡⲛⲁⲟ̄ ⲛ̄ⲓ̈ⲱⲧ 'the Great Father'; lexicon attests ⲡⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̄ⲧⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄ for Father of Greatness.
Completes ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ 'the Lights' — visible -ⲛⲉ confirms; standard lexicon form ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ.
Editor restores ⲍⲙⲁⲧ (Lyc. = ϩⲙⲟⲧ); the parallel in line 4 'all the beautiful gifts' confirms.
Initial ⲧ- of ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'all'; the visible -ⲏⲣⲟⲩ uniquely fixes the fill.

restorations.proposed_english: Likewise the beginning of all the beautiful counsels
restorations.basis: Editor restoration of the recurring litany formula; the spiritual reading places counsels here, traced to the King of Glory in the next line. ⲍⲱϩ 'likewise' fits the chapter's parallelism.

Completes ⲡⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ 'Third' before ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ on next line — but the reading attributes counsels to the King of Glory, suggesting an alternate identification; following editor's reading of the trace as 'Third [Ambassador]' which is sometimes conflated with the King of Glory in Manichaean cosmology.
Standard Manichaean title 'Third Ambassador' (lexicon: ⲡⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲙ̄ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ); also identified here with the King of Glory.

The correspondential reading explicitly names the firmament: 'King of Glory set in the firmament of the King of the Lights' (lexicon: ⲛ̄ⲥⲧⲉⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ). I correct the editor's ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ since the reading governs. Word splits across the line break, ⲡⲥⲧⲉ- ending this line.
Continuation of ⲡⲥⲧⲉⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ across the line break; ⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ is exactly 6 characters matching the apparatus est_chars=6. Yields 'in the firmament of the King of the Lights' as the reading prescribes.

Editor restores ⲧⲁⲓⲟ 'honor' completing the formula; the parallel ⲉⲡⲧⲁⲓ̈ⲁⲓ̈ⲧ 'the honor' in the next line confirms the topic. The Beloved of the Lights is the lexical entity for emanating Divine Love returning home.

restorations.proposed_english: -ed. The beginning of all the watchers
restorations.basis: Editor restoration: completes ⲉⲡⲧⲁⲓ̈ⲁⲓ̈ⲧ then resumes ⲧⲁⲣⲭⲏ formula; lexicon attests watch-station ⲡⲙⲁⲛⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲥ. Visible -ⲣⲟⲩ at line end is ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'all.' Pairs with hunters as cosmic guardians under the First Man.

Editor restoration: completes ⲡⲱⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'First Man' from previous line, then identifies him as foremost of the warriors (ⲭⲁⲙⲗⲁⲍ). The reading: First Man as commander of warriors going out against self-love.
Lexicon: Living Spirit = ⲡⲡⲛⲁ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄, also called ⲡⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ ⲡⲱⲛⲍ̄ 'Father of Life' — exactly the apposition here. The Coptic ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲥ is masculine, fitting ⲡⲡⲛⲁ.
Definite article completing ⲡⲱⲛⲥ 'the life'; standard genitive construction ⲡⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ ⲡⲱⲛⲥ 'Father of the Life.'
Standard idiom ⲥⲱⲣ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ (= scatter forth, lexicon ⲥⲁⲣⲱⲣ̄/ⲥⲁⲣ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ); reading: 'has poured out his five sons in every place' — the centrifugal scattering of the Five Sons of the First Man.
Possessive prefix; ⲙⲡⲉϩⲧⲟⲩ ⲛϣⲏⲣⲉ = 'his five sons'; standard Lyc. construction.
Word division across line: ⲁⲣⲭⲓⲧⲉⲕⲧⲱⲛ 'architects'; confirmed by following ⲡⲛⲁⲃ ⲛⲉⲕⲱⲧ 'Great Builder' (lexicon: ⲡⲛⲁⲟ̄ ⲛⲁⲣⲭⲓⲧⲉⲕⲧⲱⲛ).

Visible ⲧⲙ- before gap and the parallel construction in line 26 ('Origin of all the Wisdoms of the Truth' = ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ ⲧⲙⲏⲉ) suggest ⲧⲙⲏⲉ 'the Truth' here as well — Omophoroi of the Truth, the patience of Divine Wisdom bearing the burden of natural truth.
Pre-formula residue at section start with no apparatus traces and no parallel anchor; could be a closing phrase from the previous Omophoros statement or transitional matter. Insufficient constraint.

After 'Origin of all the Releasers' the formula expects an entity name (lexicon candidates: Jesus the Radiance, the Call, the Apostle), but the reading does not fix one and the gloss in the next line ('the one who looses to raise...') replaces the entity-name slot. No traces given. Honest non-restoration.

End of the gloss 'looses to raise those who are bound' — the next line reads 'by his words,' so {21} likely contains a brief modifier ('in the bonds' / 'in darkness'), but no traces or parallel constrain the fill.
Post-statement residue after 'Virgin of Light'; could be a closing epithet or transition to the next Origin-statement (line 28 begins '{23}-istanos who are honored'). No traces, no parallel formula.

Visible -ⲓⲥⲧⲁⲛⲟⲥ suggests a Greek loanword (-ιστής class), possibly a class of dignitaries 'who are honored,' but no clear lexicon parallel fixes the term. The reading does not name them. Honest non-restoration.
Linker between the '-istanos who are honored' phrase and 'is the Mind of Light' on next line; without knowing the subject-class, the bridging phrase cannot be reconstructed.
Connecting ⲡⲣⲉϩⲛⲉⲥⲥⲉ 'awakener' to the next-line 'sleepers' (ⲛ̄ⲕⲁⲧⲉ); standard relative-genitive 'awakener of those who sleep,' lexicon ⲛⲉⲍⲥⲉ for awaken.
Visible ⲭ_ⲣⲁⲧ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ; reading explicitly identifies 'gatherer-to-recognition of those scattered forth.' Likely a Lyc. qualitative form of ⲭⲱⲱⲣⲉ 'scatter' (ⲭⲏⲣ-), here ⲭⲏⲣⲁⲧ. Tentative.
Standard idiom ⲃⲗ̄ⲗⲉ ⲁⲣⲁ⸗ 'be blind to'; the lights and lives mentioned in the next line are the natural antecedent — 'eye not blinded to them.'

After 'since they are' (ⲛⲧⲁⲩ ⲛ̄...) before 'all the lights and lives.' The Coptic relator/preposition could be several constructions ('established in,' 'kings over,' 'in him among'); insufficient constraint.

Bridge between 'while the' (ⲉⲣⲉ ⲛ-) and the next-line word that contains ⲯⲩⲭⲁⲩⲉ 'souls.' Could be an article fragment or a longer phrase. The reading parallel ('all souls under his hand') does not uniquely fix the morphology here.

Future relative ⲡⲉⲧⲛⲁ-ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲟⲩ 'who will open them'; the next line begins ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲟⲩ ⲛ̄ϩⲙⲟⲩⲛ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'open them eight-fold out,' confirming the verb. Reading: Mind of Light opens souls eight-fold into resurrection.
